build_ernie45_vl_model: build an Ernie45-VL multimodal model with vision encoder, MoE language model, and resampler for conditional generation
create_vision_transformer: create a vision transformer with patch embedding, rotary embeddings, and attention blocks for image feature extraction
run_vision_forward_pass: run a vision forward pass on pixel values with grid dimensions to produce image features via transformer blocks
load_model_weights: load HuggingFace-compatible weights into the Ernie45-VL model with MoE expert and resampler weight mapping
get_image_video_features: extract image or video features from multimodal data items through vision encoder and variable resolution resampler
